subject: Banking
title: Revolut: The Super App
description: Learn Revolut: The Super App in one minute.

hook.text: Revolut has 40 million users in 38 countries. It offers banking, crypto, stock trading, and insurance in one app.

buildup.text: Founded in London in 2015, Revolut started with free currency exchange.

discovery.text: Revolut's multi-currency account lets you hold 36 currencies. Traveling abroad costs zero in foreign exchange fees.

twist.text: Revolut's growth brought controversy. Reports of intense work culture and compliance gaps raised concerns about scaling.

climax.text: Revolut's strategy is to replace every financial app with one super app. More features, more data, more lock-in.

punchline.text: 40 million users. Banking, crypto, stocks, insurance. One app rules all.

quiz.question: What makes Revolut a 'super app'?
options: It combines banking, trading, crypto, and insurance in one app
